correctness.rationale: The degree-2·3^s+2 polynomial t^(2·3^s+2)-t is squarefree for s>=1; genus q=3^s. Characteristic-3 Cartier coefficient extraction leaves one nonzero entry per relevant row and at most one per column. The row→column map on s ternary digits is 0w→w1 and 2w→w0; leading 1 terminates. Counting survivors gives 2^j·3^(s-j) for 0<=j<=s, 2^(2s-j) for s<=j<=2s and zero thereafter, proving nilpotence at 2s+1 and a-number 3^(s-1), p-rank 0. Independently generated all transitions for s=1..6 and all iterates; this finite check corroborates rather than proves arbitrary s. Read Katsura full primary paper, section 4 theorem 4.1 and hypotheses: f=-t+(t^(2q/3))^3 t², deg f=6(q/3+1)-4, nonzero second derivative at critical roots so Assumption (*) holds; the MW subgroup of the stable Cartier fixed space vanishes.
